regions: Northern Kenya, NE Tanzania, Southern Ethiopia
risk_factors: Rainfall variability high; drought every 3-5 years historically
traditional_practice: Mixed livestock-crop farming; storage in granaries (galla)

source: Kenya Soil Survey Reports 1910-1920 (PD); Tothill Agricultural Manual 1918 (PD)
characteristics: Highly weathered, acidic pH 5-6, low phosphorus
suitable_crops: Tea, coffee, maize (with lime), pyrethrum, potatoes
management: Lime application, organic matter addition, terracing

source: Johnston, British East Africa (1897, PD); various colonial survey reports
characteristic: Flows only during rains; subsurface water year-round in sandy bed
traditional_use: Subsurface water harvesting; sand dams (traditional practice predates 1900)
modern_application: Sand dam construction; borehole siting in riverbed
